name: Szabadbattyán (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szabadbattyán: a blue and red shield with ears of grain, a bridge and a plough, within a yellow frame.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szabadbattyán arms in a yellow frame
